english.title: Driver in security restricted area failed to produce documents - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), that was driven, parked or stopped in a security restricted area, on being requested to do so by a constable or airport official, failed to

(A)_[provide information as to identity including name and address]_
(B)_[produce either immediately or within seven days at a place specified by the constable or airport official, details of the insurance cover of the vehicle, an airside driving permit and, where applicable, a competence to drive]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 8(4) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
